title: Delayed transfers, reversals and UTR references - explained
content: If money left the sender but has not reached the receiver, first identify the payment channel and its displayed status. UPI, IMPS, NEFT and RTGS can expose different reference and reconciliation details; a reference is not a guarantee of receipt.
